title: Keep account switching responsive with repeated canonical sessions
description: Given a Person has several committed Google sessions, when central identity and account requests resolve current authorization, then immutable canonical records are read once per lookup with bounded concurrency, current session and membership checks remain enforced, and subsequent requests reread authority. Given the live account-switch incident, when latency is measured, then central request timing and exact unwanted-record provenance are recorded without deletion, email-based linking, tokens or nonce output.
